    <!-- ===========================================
         JAVASCRIPT: SLIDE CONTROLLER
         =========================================== -->
    <script>
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupBarChartAnimation();
                this.setupHeatmap();
            }

            /* === Intersection Observer for scroll-triggered animations === */
            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = idx;
                                this.updateNavDots();
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.4 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            /* === Keyboard navigation === */
            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch (e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                        case ' ':
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                        case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            /* === Touch/swipe support === */
            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                let touchStartX = 0;

                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                    touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const dy = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    const dx = touchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                    if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > 50) {
                        if (dy > 0) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                        else this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            /* === Progress bar === */
            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const pct = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            /* === Navigation dots === */
            setupNavDots() {
                const navContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    navContainer.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.navDots = navContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                if (!this.navDots) return;
                this.navDots.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }

            /* === Navigate to a specific slide === */
            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length) return;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.currentSlide = index;
                this.updateNavDots();
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            /* === Bar chart animation on slide 2 === */
            setupBarChartAnimation() {
                const slide2 = document.getElementById('slide-2');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const bars = slide2.querySelectorAll('.bar-fill');
                            bars.forEach(bar => {
                                const w = bar.getAttribute('data-width');
                                setTimeout(() => { bar.style.width = w + '%'; }, 300);
                            });
                            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3 });
                observer.observe(slide2);
            }

                const container = document.getElementById('heatmapContainer');

                const decades = [
                    { year: '1930', level: 5 },
                    { year: '1940', level: 5 },
                    { year: '1950', level: 5 },
                    { year: '1960', level: 4 },
                    { year: '1970', level: 2 },
                    { year: '1980', level: 1 },
                    { year: '1990', level: 0 },
                    { year: '2000', level: 0 },
                    { year: '2010', level: 0 },
                    { year: '2020', level: 0 },
                ];

                const stateCount = 50;

                /* Color scale: 0=#1a2744, 1=#1e5f8a, 2=#2196c4, 3=#e8a838, 4=#e05c2e, 5=#b91c1c */
                const colors = ['#1a2744', '#1e5f8a', '#2196c4', '#e8a838', '#e05c2e', '#b91c1c'];

                decades.forEach(decade => {
                    const row = document.createElement('div');
                    row.className = 'heatmap-row';

                    const label = document.createElement('span');
                    label.className = 'heatmap-year-label';
                    label.textContent = decade.year;
                    row.appendChild(label);

                    const cells = document.createElement('div');
                    cells.className = 'heatmap-cells';

                    for (let i = 0; i < stateCount; i++) {
                        const cell = document.createElement('div');
                        cell.className = 'heatmap-cell';

                        let colorIdx;
                        if (decade.level === 0) {
                            /* Near zero: mostly 0, rare 1 */
                            colorIdx = Math.random() < 0.92 ? 0 : 1;
                        } else if (decade.level === 1) {
                            /* Very low */
                            colorIdx = Math.random() < 0.6 ? 0 : (Math.random() < 0.7 ? 1 : 2);
                        } else if (decade.level === 2) {
                            /* Mixed low-medium */
                            const r = Math.random();
                            colorIdx = r < 0.2 ? 0 : r < 0.5 ? 1 : r < 0.8 ? 2 : 3;
                        } else if (decade.level === 4) {
                            /* Transition */
                            const r = Math.random();
                            colorIdx = r < 0.05 ? 1 : r < 0.15 ? 2 : r < 0.4 ? 3 : r < 0.7 ? 4 : 5;
                        } else {
                            /* High incidence */
                            const r = Math.random();
                            colorIdx = r < 0.02 ? 2 : r < 0.08 ? 3 : r < 0.35 ? 4 : 5;
                        }

                        cell.style.backgroundColor = colors[colorIdx];
                        cells.appendChild(cell);
                    }

                    row.appendChild(cells);
                    container.appendChild(row);
                });

    <script>
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupBarChartAnimation();
                this.setupHeatmap();
            }

            /* === Intersection Observer for scroll-triggered animations === */
            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = idx;
                                this.updateNavDots();
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.4 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            /* === Keyboard navigation === */
            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch (e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                        case ' ':
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                        case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            /* === Touch/swipe support === */
            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                let touchStartX = 0;

                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                    touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const dy = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    const dx = touchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                    if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > 50) {
                        if (dy > 0) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                        else this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            /* === Progress bar === */
            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const pct = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            /* === Navigation dots === */
            setupNavDots() {
                const navContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    navContainer.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.navDots = navContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                if (!this.navDots) return;
                this.navDots.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }

            /* === Navigate to a specific slide === */
            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length) return;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.currentSlide = index;
                this.updateNavDots();
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            /* === Bar chart animation on slide 2 === */
            setupBarChartAnimation() {
                const slide2 = document.getElementById('slide-2');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const bars = slide2.querySelectorAll('.bar-fill');
                            bars.forEach(bar => {
                                const w = bar.getAttribute('data-width');
                                setTimeout(() => { bar.style.width = w + '%'; }, 300);
                            });
                            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3 });
                observer.observe(slide2);
            }

            /* === Heatmap generation for slide 4 === */
            setupHeatmap() {
                const container = document.getElementById('heatmapContainer');
                if (!container) return;

                /* Generate representative heatmap rows for key decades */
                const decades = [
                    { year: '1930', level: 5 },
                    { year: '1940', level: 5 },
                    { year: '1950', level: 5 },
                    { year: '1960', level: 4 },
                    { year: '1970', level: 2 },
                    { year: '1980', level: 1 },
                    { year: '1990', level: 0 },
                    { year: '2000', level: 0 },
                    { year: '2010', level: 0 },
                    { year: '2020', level: 0 },
                ];

                const stateCount = 50;

                /* Color scale: 0=#1a2744, 1=#1e5f8a, 2=#2196c4, 3=#e8a838, 4=#e05c2e, 5=#b91c1c */
                const colors = ['#1a2744', '#1e5f8a', '#2196c4', '#e8a838', '#e05c2e', '#b91c1c'];

                decades.forEach(decade => {
                    const row = document.createElement('div');
                    row.className = 'heatmap-row';

                    const label = document.createElement('span');
                    label.className = 'heatmap-year-label';
                    label.textContent = decade.year;
                    row.appendChild(label);

                    const cells = document.createElement('div');
                    cells.className = 'heatmap-cells';

                    for (let i = 0; i < stateCount; i++) {
                        const cell = document.createElement('div');
                        cell.className = 'heatmap-cell';

                        let colorIdx;
                        if (decade.level === 0) {
                            /* Near zero: mostly 0, rare 1 */
                            colorIdx = Math.random() < 0.92 ? 0 : 1;
                        } else if (decade.level === 1) {
                            /* Very low */
                            colorIdx = Math.random() < 0.6 ? 0 : (Math.random() < 0.7 ? 1 : 2);
                        } else if (decade.level === 2) {
                            /* Mixed low-medium */
                            const r = Math.random();
                            colorIdx = r < 0.2 ? 0 : r < 0.5 ? 1 : r < 0.8 ? 2 : 3;
                        } else if (decade.level === 4) {
                            /* Transition */
                            const r = Math.random();
                            colorIdx = r < 0.05 ? 1 : r < 0.15 ? 2 : r < 0.4 ? 3 : r < 0.7 ? 4 : 5;
                        } else {
                            /* High incidence */
                            const r = Math.random();
                            colorIdx = r < 0.02 ? 2 : r < 0.08 ? 3 : r < 0.35 ? 4 : 5;
                        }

                        cell.style.backgroundColor = colors[colorIdx];
                        cells.appendChild(cell);
                    }

                    row.appendChild(cells);
                    container.appendChild(row);
                });
            }
        }

        /* Initialize */
        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

        .slide.visible .stagger-children > *:nth-child(8) { transition-delay: 0.8s; opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

        /* ===========================================

                radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 70%, rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.1) 0%, transparent 60%),

            line-height: 1.5;
            margin-bottom: clamp(1rem, 3vh, 2.5rem);

        .title-meta {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .title-meta span {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.4em;
        }

        .title-divider {
            width: min(200px, 30vw);
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent-teal), transparent);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.5rem);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: VACCINE TIMELINE
           =========================================== */
        .bar-chart-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.25rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
            width: 100%;
            max-height: min(60vh, 480px);
        }

        .bar-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(70px, 10vw, 130px) 1fr clamp(35px, 4vw, 55px);
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
        }

        .bar-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: right;
            white-space: nowrap;

        .bar-fill.covid {

        }

        .bar-value {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);

        }

        .bar-value.covid-value {

        }

        .covid-highlight {

        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: DISEASE ELIMINATION TABLE
           =========================================== */
        .data-table-wrapper {
            overflow: hidden;
            width: 100%;
        }

        .data-table {
            width: 100%;

        }

        .data-table thead th {

            color: var(--accent-teal);
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.6rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);

            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border-accent);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .data-table tbody td {
            padding: clamp(0.25rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .data-table tbody tr:hover {
            background: rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.04);
        }

        .eliminated {
            color: var(--accent-green);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .partial {
            color: var(--accent-amber);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .disease-name {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: MEASLES HEATMAP
           =========================================== */
        .heatmap-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }

        .heatmap-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem);
        }

        .heatmap-year-label {
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            width: clamp(30px, 4vw, 45px);
            text-align: right;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .heatmap-cells {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1px;
            flex: 1;
        }

        .heatmap-cell {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(8px, 1.2vh, 14px);
            border-radius: 2px;
            min-width: 0;
        }

        .heatmap-legend {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            justify-content: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .legend-swatch {
            width: clamp(16px, 2vw, 28px);
            height: clamp(8px, 1vh, 12px);
            border-radius: 2px;
            display: inline-block;
        }

        .milestone-markers {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .milestone {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.4em;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .milestone-dot {
            width: clamp(6px, 0.6vw, 10px);
            height: clamp(6px, 0.6vw, 10px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: SMALLPOX ERADICATION
           =========================================== */
        .timeline-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0;
            position: relative;
            padding-left: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
        }

        .timeline-container::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
            top: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            width: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent-teal), var(--accent-green), var(--accent-amber));
        }

        .timeline-item {
            position: relative;
            padding-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
        }

        .timeline-item::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: calc(-1 * clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem) + clamp(0.35rem, 0.9vw, 0.7rem));
            top: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
            width: clamp(8px, 0.8vw, 12px);
            height: clamp(8px, 0.8vw, 12px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--accent-teal);
            border: 2px solid var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .timeline-year {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.85rem, 1.5vw, 1.15rem);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            font-weight: 700;

        .timeline-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);

        .eradication-factors {

        .factor-card {

            text-align: center;
        }

        .factor-card .factor-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.8vw, 1.5rem);
            margin-bottom: 0.2em;
        }

        .factor-card .factor-text {
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6: HERD IMMUNITY
           =========================================== */
        .herd-diagram {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .herd-visual {
            position: relative;
            width: clamp(180px, 30vw, 320px);
            height: clamp(180px, 30vw, 320px);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .herd-visual svg {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
        }

        .herd-explanation {
            max-width: min(450px, 45vw);
        }

        .herd-explanation h3 {
            font-size: clamp(0.95rem, 1.8vw, 1.35rem);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.8rem);

        .herd-point {

            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: 0.5em;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.6rem);

            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;

            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            margin-top: 0.35em;
        }

            left: 0;

            color: var(--accent-teal);

        .takeaway-text {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;

        .takeaway-text strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);

            margin-top: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);

        .cta-text {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.1rem);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            font-weight: 700;

        .cta-subtext {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 0.3em;

        /* ===========================================
           UTILITY CLASSES

        .text-accent { color: var(--accent-teal); }
        .text-green { color: var(--accent-green); }
        .text-amber { color: var(--accent-amber); }

        .text-muted { color: var(--text-muted); }
        .text-secondary { color: var(--text-secondary); }

        .slide-header {
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.5rem);
        }

        .slide-title {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.75rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);

        .slide-subtitle {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.3em;
            padding: 0.15em 0.6em;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        }

        .badge-green { background: var(--accent-green-glow); color: var(--accent-green); }
        .badge-amber { background: var(--accent-amber-glow); color: var(--accent-amber); }

    <!-- ===========================================
         JAVASCRIPT: SLIDE CONTROLLER
         =========================================== -->
    <script>
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupBarChartAnimation();
                this.setupHeatmap();
            }

            /* === Intersection Observer for scroll-triggered animations === */
            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = idx;
                                this.updateNavDots();
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.4 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            /* === Keyboard navigation === */
            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch (e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                        case ' ':
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                        case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            /* === Touch/swipe support === */
            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                let touchStartX = 0;

                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                    touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const dy = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    const dx = touchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                    if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > 50) {
                        if (dy > 0) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                        else this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            /* === Progress bar === */
            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const pct = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            /* === Navigation dots === */
            setupNavDots() {
                const navContainer = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    navContainer.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.navDots = navContainer.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                if (!this.navDots) return;
                this.navDots.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }

            /* === Navigate to a specific slide === */
            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length) return;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.currentSlide = index;
                this.updateNavDots();
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            /* === Bar chart animation on slide 2 === */
            setupBarChartAnimation() {
                const slide2 = document.getElementById('slide-2');
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            const bars = slide2.querySelectorAll('.bar-fill');
                            bars.forEach(bar => {
                                const w = bar.getAttribute('data-width');
                                setTimeout(() => { bar.style.width = w + '%'; }, 300);
                            });
                            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.3 });
                observer.observe(slide2);
            }

            /* === Heatmap generation for slide 4 === */
            setupHeatmap() {
                const container = document.getElementById('heatmapContainer');
                if (!container) return;

                /* Generate representative heatmap rows for key decades */
                const decades = [
                    { year: '1930', level: 5 },
                    { year: '1940', level: 5 },
                    { year: '1950', level: 5 },
                    { year: '1960', level: 4 },
                    { year: '1970', level: 2 },
                    { year: '1980', level: 1 },
                    { year: '1990', level: 0 },
                    { year: '2000', level: 0 },
                    { year: '2010', level: 0 },
                    { year: '2020', level: 0 },
                ];

                const stateCount = 50;

                /* Color scale: 0=#1a2744, 1=#1e5f8a, 2=#2196c4, 3=#e8a838, 4=#e05c2e, 5=#b91c1c */
                const colors = ['#1a2744', '#1e5f8a', '#2196c4', '#e8a838', '#e05c2e', '#b91c1c'];

                decades.forEach(decade => {

                            colorIdx = Math.random() < 0.92 ? 0 : 1;
                        } else if (decade.level === 1) {

                        }

                        cell.style.backgroundColor = colors[colorIdx];
                        cells.appendChild(cell);
                    }

                    row.appendChild(cells);
                    container.appendChild(row);
                });
